boundaryGate.question: After controller accepted the previous Test run as execution-boundary blocked only, can Test rerun the real BiliDili P10 project-index workflow-unify parity route without default preclean or cross-root log cleanup?
boundaryGate.objectBoundary: Real BiliDili workspace only, using configured local Alembic/AlembicPlugin/AlembicCore/BiliDili sources and existing DeepSeek generation plus local Qwen embedding provider setup.
controllerSelfChecks: Controller reviewed the previous Test TargetResultEnvelope, report, and summary and accepted it only as execution-boundary blocked evidence.
Controller independently confirmed the default Test restart script preclean discovers multiple ~/.asd workspace roots and can clean logs outside the BiliDili data root.
Controller confirmed the repaired BiliDili runtime DB integrity check is ok and the current BiliDili daemon route is healthy enough for Test to verify before reuse.
Controller did not accept P10 parity, G4 coverage, G6 twin/shim removal, or final demand completion from the blocked result.
realScenarioConditions: Use direct real BiliDili workspace; no sandbox copy.
Create a task-local Test/tmp/p10-bilidili-no-preclean-parity-rerun-t1/ directory for raw JSON, logs, DB summaries, and parity artifacts.
Prefer the existing BiliDili daemon only if verify-test-environment proves it is ready and points to the BiliDili data root.
If restart is required, use the BiliDili restart route with --no-preclean and prove preclean was skipped.
Do not run the default preclean path and do not clean logs under unrelated ~/.asd workspace roots.
If the current Test Alembic MCP transport is closed, do not reload or repair MCP from Test; use the approved Dashboard/daemon real route and record the MCP blockage as evidence.
successMeans: Environment/source/provider/R-2 proof is captured before any destructive reset.
Runtime DB integrity and schema are captured before official rebuild/rescan.
Official rebuild or host route produces non-empty target-scoped coverage with coverageLedgerSeed evidence.
In-process moduleScope route produces non-empty target-scoped coverage.
Host vs in-process parity diff is empty and the pass is not 0-vs-0 empty parity.
Coverage output contains no aggregate/root module ids and no stale active sessions or open deep-mining rounds remain.
Raw artifacts include environment, health, test-mode, DB integrity/schema, source pins, git cleanliness, coverage summaries, and parity diff.
failureMeans: Any restart uses default preclean or touches unrelated ~/.asd roots.
Test requires MCP repair or plugin reload to continue.
verify-test-environment does not prove a BiliDili data root.
Bootstrap/rebuild/rescan fails or produces empty target-scoped coverage.
Coverage includes aggregate/root module ids, lacks coverageLedgerSeed, or leaves stale sessions/open rounds.
Host/in-process parity diff is non-empty or only 0-vs-0 empty parity is shown.
cannotConclude: Cannot conclude P10 complete from a healthy daemon, DB integrity ok, or restart success alone.
Cannot conclude G4/G6 or final demand completion unless the corresponding gates are explicitly evidenced.
Cannot treat a Test MCP transport failure as a product-source regression without source-path evidence.
Cannot treat empty host/in-process outputs as parity success.
stopConditions: R-2 root/dataRoot proof fails or source/provider pins mismatch.
The run would clean logs or mutate files outside the BiliDili data root.
The only available path requires Test to repair/reload Alembic MCP.
Official rebuild/rescan blocks on stale session, DB corruption, missing schema, or reset errors.
Any manual DB/session/provider/source mutation would be required to create a pass.

evidenceRequired: Task-local raw JSON under Test/tmp/p10-bilidili-no-preclean-parity-rerun-t1/ for environment, daemon health, test-mode, DB integrity/schema, source pins, git cleanliness, coverage summaries, and parity diff.
Source pin summary for Alembic, AlembicPlugin, AlembicCore, and BiliDili workspace commit/state.
R-2 proof before destructive reset and proof that any reused daemon points to the BiliDili data root.
Restart evidence only if restart is needed, including --no-preclean and skipped preclean proof.
Bootstrap/rebuild/rescan runtime JSON and log summary, including fullReset/session evidence.
DB/coverage ledger summaries showing target scope, non-empty cells, coverageLedgerSeed, and absence of aggregate/root module ids.
Host vs in-process parity diff artifact and statement that it is not 0-vs-0.
TargetResultEnvelope with commands, outputs, risks, blocked conditions if any, and next recommendation.
allowedOperations: Read BiliDili/Alembic runtime files and logs needed for evidence.
Use the existing healthy BiliDili daemon if Test proves it is ready and BiliDili-scoped.
Run BiliDili real workspace bootstrap/rescan verification commands through the configured local Alembic Dashboard/daemon route.
Restart the BiliDili route only with --no-preclean when restart is required.
Collect runtime JSON, log excerpts, DB/ledger summaries, parity diff, and source pin evidence.
forbiddenOperations: Do not clean logs or mutate files under unrelated ~/.asd workspace roots.
Do not repair, reload, or stop Alembic MCP from Test.
Do not manually edit DB rows, session files, provider config, package versions, or source to create a pass.
Do not change product code in Test.

suggestedTaskPackage.summary: Rerun real BiliDili P10 host/in-process parity from the repaired data-root state, using no-preclean/no-cross-root Test route and task-local raw evidence.
